# e2e_kubernetes (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a specific E2E Kubernetes cluster.

~> **Migration Notice**: This data source has parameter changes in v3.0.0. See the [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](../guides/upgrade-to-v3.md#affected-resources) for migration instructions.

## Example Usage

```hcl
# Retrieve information about a specific Kubernetes cluster
data "e2e_kubernetes" "cluster" {
  service_id = "k8s-service-12345"
  project_id = "12345"      # Use quoted string for project_id
  region     = "Delhi NCR"  # Use 'region' instead of deprecated 'location'
}

# Use the retrieved cluster information
output "cluster_status" {
  value = data.e2e_kubernetes.cluster.status
}

output "cluster_version" {
  value = data.e2e_kubernetes.cluster.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Argument Reference

- `project_id` (Required) (String) The ID of the project as a string (e.g., `"12345"`). **Note**: Changed from integer to string in v2.x with numeric validation. Terraform auto-converts unquoted integers, but we recommend quoting for consistency.
- `service_id` (Required) (String) Service ID of the Kubernetes cluster. It must be unique.
- `region` (Required) (String) Region where the Kubernetes cluster is located. This is the standard parameter name for specifying the location.
- `location` (Optional, **Deprecated**) (String) **DEPRECATED**: Use 'region' instead. This parameter will be removed in version 3.0.0. Location where the Kubernetes cluster is located.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the Kubernetes service
- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the Kubernetes Service
- `master_node_id` (String) ID of the master node of the kubernetes cluster
- `status` (String) Status of the Kubernetes cluster
- `version` (String) Version of the Kubernetes Cluster
